sources.entry: Audiobookshelf - Audiobook and podcast server. It streams all audio formats, keeps and syncs progress across devices. Comes with apps for Android and iOS. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Docker/deb/Nodejs
Audiobookshelf | Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server with a web player and mobile apps.

summary.one_liner: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server with a web player, multi-user progress syncing, and Android and iOS apps.
summary.what_it_does: Streams audiobooks and podcasts from a self-hosted server in any audio format, transcoding on the fly. It keeps per-user listening progress and syncs it across devices. It can search and add podcasts, download episodes with auto-download, and auto-detect library changes without a rescan. Users can upload media through bulk upload and drag-and-drop folders, and metadata and cover art are fetched from several sources. Additional features include a chapter editor with Audnexus lookup, merging audio files into a single m4b, embedding metadata into audio files, basic ebook support (epub, pdf, cbr, cbz) with an ereader and send-to-device, and open RSS feeds for podcasts and audiobooks. Chromecast works from the web and Android apps.
use_cases: listen to podcasts on my own server
share an audiobook library with multiple family members
merge audio files into one m4b
read ebooks in a browser-based reader
how_to_run: Installation instructions are in the external install docs (not included in this README)
For development: install Node.js 24 and FFmpeg, create dev.js from .devcontainer/dev.js
cd client && npm ci && npm run generate && cd ..
npm run dev (server at configured port, client at localhost:3333)
Or use the VS Code dev container and 'Rebuild and Reopen in Container'
notable: Includes Android and iOS apps (both in beta), listed as open source alongside the server
Chapter editor and chapter lookup via the Audnexus API
Open RSS feeds for podcasts and audiobooks
Progressive Web App with Chromecast support
caveats: Frontend pull requests are not being reviewed or merged for the existing Vue frontend; a React rewrite is in progress
iOS app beta is full (Apple's 10k tester limit)
Requires a websocket connection through any reverse proxy; subfolder path must be /audiobookshelf
keywords: listen to audiobooks on my server
